issue.title: test_stream_json_lines_dispatches_stderr_during_a_large_stdout_burst flakes under a loaded full check

task_type_fields.evidence: In the sase-1hf landing's full-suite `just check` (master 3a4178b15a plus the landing diff, host load ~80, 2026-10-07) it failed once. Serial reruns on the same unchanged tree: fail, pass, pass. It passed once on a clean tree. Timing-sensitive: stderr must be dispatched while a large stdout burst streams. sase-1hf touches no llm_provider subprocess code.

issue.creation_reason: Failed once in the sase-1hf landing's full-suite check and then failed 1 of 3 serial reruns on an unchanged tree, so it intermittently reds unrelated landings.

evidence.note: Full CI run 37993930903 on tip 7c6039f1e68483cbc1a206e7745a32830c4429db failed this same node once in job full / test (3.14) (job 114039268827): tests/llm_provider/test_subprocess_utf8_decode.py:359 assert 1200 < 1200, so stderr was observed only after all 1200 stdout events. The rest of that job was 54308 passed, 128 skipped. full / test (3.12) and full / test (3.13) on the same run succeeded. Epic sase-1io.7.6 does not touch llm_provider subprocess streaming. This is the independent CI reproduction; the release epic will retry the job once if it fails again and will not edit the test.

Independent CI evidence: the approved 202610/fix_ci_test_jobs.md review found this node failed once among six Full CI runs on the 3.13 test leg (assert 1200 < 1200), then passed when rerun locally at master HEAD. It is a timing-sensitive stderr-dispatch flake unrelated to the reviewed change.

payload.description: Compare the recent CI failure with the planned UTF-8 stderr dispatch flake

payload.entry: Root cause reproduced: the child wrote the stdout burst and then stderr as two separate writes while the reader was already running, so a descheduled child let the reader drain all 1200 records first (assert 1200 < 1200; a 0.3s gap between the writes fails the old test every time). Fixed in phase sase-1mk.5: the reader now starts only after the child confirms both pipes are written, and the test asserts the explicit contract that pending stderr is read within one _JSONL_RECORD_BUDGET of the stdout backlog. No production change.

payload.description: Root-causing this flake for phase sase-1mk.5

payload.entry: Fixed by phase sase-1mk.5; 56,425 checks passed and nine -n 8 stress runs were stable. Release Full CI 39229885153 and Master Gate 39237716543 passed. Evidence: file:explicit:588c932adae1aadce88ef449.

payload.close_reason: The phase directly repaired the issues and the recorded stress checks plus release gates passed.
